```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

class DataCleaning:
    def __init__(self):
        self.actions_log = []

    def clean(self, data: pd.DataFrame):
        # Clip outliers / right-censoring 
        self.actions_log.append("Clipping VehAge (<=20), DrivAge (<=90), BonusMalus (<=150), ClaimNb (<=5).")
        data['VehAge'] = data['VehAge'].clip(upper=20)
        data['DrivAge'] = data['DrivAge'].clip(upper=90)
        data['BonusMalus'] = data['BonusMalus'].clip(upper=150)
        data['ClaimNb'] = data['ClaimNb'].clip(upper=5)

        # Encode categorical variables
        data['VehBrand'] = pd.get_dummies(data['VehBrand'])
        data['VehGas'] = pd.get_dummies(data['VehGas'])
        data['Region'] = pd.get_dummies(data['Region'])
        data['Area'] = pd.get_dummies(data['Area'])

        self.actions_log.append("Encoded categorical variables (VehBrand, VehGas, Region, Area).")

        # Scale numeric variables
        from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
        scaler = MinMaxScaler()
        numeric_cols = ['VehAge', 'DrivAge', 'AnnualMileage']
        data[numeric_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(data[numeric_cols])

        self.actions_log.append("Scaled numeric variables (VehAge, DrivAge, AnnualMileage).")

        # Check for correlations
        corr_matrix = data.corr()
        corr_abs = corr_matrix.abs()
        corr_matrix.loc[:,:] = np.tril(corr_matrix, k=-1)
        max_corr = corr_matrix.max().max()
        self.actions_log.append(f"Correlation matrix max: {max_corr}")

        # Data normalization
        from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
        scaler = StandardScaler()
        data[numeric_cols] = scaler.fit_transform(data[numeric_cols])

        self.actions_log.append("Normalized numeric variables (VehAge, DrivAge, AnnualMileage).")

        # Remove missing values
        empty_cols = data.columns[data.isna().all()].tolist()
        if empty_cols:
            data = data.drop(columns=empty_cols)
        
        data = data.dropna()
    
        return data
```
